name: Auto Block Translation
description: Adds an 'Automatic Translation' tab/operation to custom content blocks that machine-translates their text fields into selected languages, using the translation provider configured in the parent Auto Node Translate module.
project_description:
This module provides the ability to add automatic translations to custom blocks using external libraries.

 
 
 
 This is a sub-module of Auto Node Translate . 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 At the moment the module provides 5 different Translation APIs:

 
 Amazon Translate (^2.1)

 https://aws.amazon.com/translate 
 MyMemory

 https://mymemory.translated.net/ 
 IBM Watson translator

 https://www.ibm.com/cloud/watson-language-translator 
 Google cloud translator v2

 https://cloud.google.com/dotnet/docs/reference/Google.Cloud.Translation… 
 Google cloud translator v3
 https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/reference/rpc/google.cloud.tran… 

 
 
 
 
 For version 2 check available providers here . 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Normal module installation procedure. 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 Auto Node Translate 

 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 Configure the Automatic Translation at (/admin/config/auto_node_translate/config).

 
 Back to top 

 Using 
 
 Choose an API in the settings page. 
 Create a translatable custom block, in any language. 
 Click on the "Automatic Translation" tab. 
 Choose the language(s) you want to translate to. 
 This module will create or update the translations of the selected languages, automatically translating all text fields.
